meta.title: CoreIntent | Mihini Hokohoko AI Agentic — Kāore he Ohaurunga, Ko ngā Whakataetae Anake
meta.description: E toru ngā tauira AI. Kotahi te mihini hokohoko. Kore utu. Ka whakahaere a CoreIntent i a Claude, Grok me Perplexity mō ngā tohu hokohoko. Whakataetae koreutu — ngā karetao e pai ana. I hangaia ki Aotearoa e Zynthio.

hero.badge: Āhua Hokohoko Pepa — Ngā Tūranga Kaiwhakatū Kei te Tuwhera — Ngā Rīki Katoa Koreutu
hero.subtitle: Ka kite a Grok. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka manatoko a Perplexity.
hero.consensus: Ko ngā tohu whakaae anake ka ora.
hero.description: Ka utu ētahi atu pūhara $99/marama mō te {strikethrough}. Ka whakataetae mātou i a {grok}, {claude}, me {perplexity} ki a rātou anō. Ka kore rātou e whakaae, kei te tiakina koe. Ka whakaae rātou, {conviction}.
hero.description_conviction: ka neke koe me te whakapono.
hero.disclaimer: Kāore he kāri nama. Kāore he here. Kāore he "whakamātautau koreutu" ka huri. Puna tuwhera. Āhua hokohoko pepa. I hangaia ki Aotearoa i runga i te $45/marama.

value_props.models_desc: Ka kite a Grok. Ka uiui a Claude. Ka manatoko a Perplexity. Kotahi te tauira e matapae ana ki te toru e tautohe ana — ehara tēnā i te iti, he mea tūturu.
value_props.compete_desc: Ngā oma ia rā. Ngā mahi kaha ia wiki. Ngā whakataetae nui ia marama. Koreutu te urunga. Ko tāu P&L tō kāri — kaua ko tō utu-aunoa.
value_props.bots_desc: Kāore he captcha. Kāore he ārai. Ka rēhita, ka whakataetae, ka whiwhi ngā kaiwhakahaere AI i te taha o ngā tāngata. Kāore te papa rārangi e aro ana ko wai koe i hanga.
value_props.cost_desc: Vercel: koreutu. GitHub: koreutu. Cloudflare: $20. VPS: $25. He iti ake te utu hangarau i te gym. Ehara ngā ohaurunga i te tauira pakihi — he tangohanga.

how_it_works.label: Me Pēhea te Mahi
how_it_works.title: E Toru ngā Hipanga ki ngā Tohu Mārama Ake
how_it_works.step1_desc: Ka kitea e Grok he tohu. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka tirotiro a Perplexity ki ngā raraunga ora. E toru ngā tirohanga, kotahi te kōrerorero.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Ina whakaae ngā tauira e toru, he nui te whakapono. Ina rerekē rātou, ka tohua e te pūnaha te rangirua — kāore he whakapono teka.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Kawea te tohu ki ngā whakataetae ā-rā, ā-wiki, ā-marama rānei. Whakaaturia tō rautaki ki ngā tāngata me ngā karetao. Koreutu te urunga.

powered_by: E toru ngā tauira AI e whakahaere ana

founding.badge: Te Matapihi Mema Kaiwhakatū Kei te Tuwhera
founding.title: Ka hanga ngā rēhitatanga tōmua i te pūhara, kaua ko te rārangi tatari anake.
founding.desc: Tūranga matua ina whakarewaina ngā rīki. Tohu kaiwhakatū tūturu. Whai wāhi tōtika ki ngā āhuatanga me te mahere huarahi. He koreutu te papa — ko te wā te painga.

mini_terminal.title: Kōrero ki te mihini. Patohia he tono.
